title: Champion of YUNet Esports Arena Invitationals 2026 (CS:GO)
subtitle: Airtel Presents YUNet Esports Arena Invitationals 2026 Powered by Corsair
about: The YUNet Esports Arena Invitationals 2026, presented by Airtel and powered by Corsair, was a premier invitational Counter-Strike: Global Offensive (CS:GO) tournament held in Bangladesh in March 2026. The event brought together the nation's top CS:GO teams in an exclusive invitational format, featuring high-level competition, professional production, and significant prize pools. As an invitational tournament, only the most accomplished and elite teams received invitations to compete, making it one of the most prestigious CS:GO events in Bangladesh. The tournament showcased the highest level of competitive Counter-Strike in the country.
description: I competed with Red ViperZ Gaming at the YUNet Esports Arena Invitationals 2026, an exclusive invitational tournament featuring Bangladesh's elite CS:GO teams. Our team demonstrated exceptional skill, strategic depth, and flawless execution throughout the competition to secure the championship title. Competing against hand-picked top teams in this prestigious invitational format, we proved our dominance in the Bangladeshi CS:GO scene once again. The victory at this high-profile event, backed by major sponsors like Airtel and Corsair, further solidified our legacy as the premier Counter-Strike team in Bangladesh.
quote: Being invited to compete is an honor, but winning the championship is a statement—a reminder that excellence is not given, it's earned through dedication and performance.
learning: Mastered performance under the pressure of competing in an exclusive invitational format.
Developed advanced strategies to counter Bangladesh's most elite teams.
Enhanced ability to maintain consistency and composure in high-stakes matches.
Learned to represent sponsors professionally while delivering championship-level performance.
Gained experience competing in premium tournament environments with top-tier production.

title: 20th Place at App Showcasing Event - PC Builder Desktop App
subtitle: AIUB CS Fest 2024
about: AIUB CS Fest 2024 was a large-scale technology and innovation event organized by the Department of Computer Science at AIUB. The festival featured multiple segments including App Showcasing, Game Showcasing, Web Applications, Desktop Applications, and Mobile Applications. Students and teams from various backgrounds presented their projects, exchanged ideas, and received feedback from peers and faculty members. The event created an engaging platform for showcasing creativity, technical skills, and real-world problem-solving approaches.
description: I built and showcased a PC Builder desktop application to industry leading experts from prestigious companies of Bangladesh at AIUB CS Fest 2024 under the "App Showcasing" segment. The application allows users to either order a complete custom PC build or purchase individual components. A key highlight of the system is its compatibility-based component selection, where users are only shown components that are compatible with the current build configuration. The app also implements role-based access control for Admin, Staff, and Customers, ensuring secure and organized management of orders and data. The project was developed as a desktop application using C# and MySQL.
quote: Building software is one thing, but showcasing it in front of industry leading professionals teaches you how real users think—and that lesson is priceless.
learning: How to present a technical product clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
The importance of user experience and logical constraints, especially in compatibility-based systems.
Practical implementation of role-based access control in a real application.
Handling real-time feedback and questions during live demonstrations.
Gained confidence in explaining design decisions, system architecture, and features.

title: Most Valuable Player Award at D1 Cup Season 2 (CS:GO)
subtitle: Discovery One Cup Season 2
about: Discovery One Cup Season 2 was a large-scale national eSports event held at the Bashundhara Convention Center, Bangladesh, in September 2023. The event featured multiple competitive gaming tournaments including Counter-Strike: Global Offensive (CS:GO), Valorant, and Mobile Legends: Bang Bang (MLBB). Recognized as one of the biggest national eSports events ever hosted in Bangladesh, the tournament brought together top teams and players from across the country, creating a highly competitive and professional gaming environment.
description: I participated in the Counter-Strike: Global Offensive (CS:GO) segment of Discovery One Cup Season 2 with Red ViperZ Gaming. Our team emerged as the tournament champion, remaining completely unbeaten throughout the event without losing a single map. I was awarded the Most Valuable Player (MVP) title for achieving the highest number of frags across the entire tournament. This achievement reflects strong individual performance, teamwork, consistency, and the ability to perform under high-pressure competitive scenarios.
quote: Winning is special, but earning MVP while staying unbeaten as a team proves the power of preparation, trust, and discipline.
learning: Developed strong teamwork and in-game communication skills in a competitive environment.
Improved decision-making and composure under high-pressure match situations.
Learned the importance of preparation, strategy execution, and role discipline.
Enhanced mechanical skill consistency and situational awareness during tournaments.
Gained experience performing confidently on a national stage in front of live audiences.

title: Undefeated Champion of Discovery One Cup Season 2 (CS:GO)
subtitle: Discovery One Cup Season 2 - CS:GO Championship
about: Discovery One Cup Season 2 was the last and biggest national Counter-Strike: Global Offensive (CS:GO) LAN event ever held in Bangladesh. Organized at the Bashundhara Convention Center in September 2023, the tournament marked a historic moment in Bangladeshi esports history. The event brought together the nation's most elite CS:GO teams in a high-stakes offline competition, featuring intense matches, live audiences, and professional production quality. As the final major CS:GO LAN tournament in Bangladesh before the transition to Counter-Strike 2, this event represented the culmination of years of competitive CS:GO in the country.
description: I competed with Red ViperZ Gaming in Discovery One Cup Season 2, the final and largest national CS:GO LAN tournament in Bangladesh's history. Our team delivered a flawless performance, remaining completely undefeated throughout the entire tournament without dropping a single map. Competing against Bangladesh's top teams in a LAN environment, we demonstrated superior teamwork, strategic execution, and individual skill to secure the championship title. This undefeated run at the nation's biggest CS:GO event solidified our position as the dominant force in Bangladeshi Counter-Strike and marked a perfect conclusion to the CS:GO era in Bangladesh.
quote: To remain undefeated at the biggest stage is not luck—it's the result of countless hours of practice, unwavering team trust, and the refusal to accept anything less than perfection.
learning: Mastered the mental fortitude required to maintain an undefeated streak under immense pressure.
Developed exceptional team coordination and communication in high-stakes LAN environment.
Learned to adapt strategies mid-tournament while maintaining dominant performance.
Enhanced ability to perform consistently across multiple best-of-three series without fatigue.
Understood the legacy and responsibility of being undefeated champions at a historic event.

title: Represented Bangladesh at IESF 14th World Esports Championship Bali 2022
subtitle: IESF 14th World Esports Championship Bali 2022
about: The IESF 14th World Esports Championship 2022 is the flagship global competitive gaming event organized by the International Esports Federation (IESF). It was held in Bali, Indonesia, in December 2022 with competitors representing over 100 countries across multiple game titles, including Counter-Strike: Global Offensive (CS:GO). The championship brought together world-class national teams and esports federations, promoting competitive excellence, cultural exchange, and international sportsmanship.
description: I represented Bangladesh as a member of Red ViperZ Gaming in the Counter-Strike: Global Offensive (CS:GO) division at the IESF 14th World Esports Championship Bali 2022. After qualifying through national and regional competitions against teams from India, Pakistan, Nepal, and Sri Lanka, we competed on the world stage against elite international teams. Although we were eliminated in the group stage, the experience provided invaluable exposure to global competition standards and marked a historic milestone as the only Bangladeshi CS:GO team to reach the IESF World Championship.
quote: Standing on the world stage reminded me that true growth comes not from winning or losing, but from pushing beyond familiar limits and learning from the best.
learning: Experienced the intensity and discipline required at world-class esports tournaments.
Learned to adapt strategies against diverse international playstyles.
Developed mental resilience and confidence competing on a global stage.
Gained insight into professional preparation, teamwork, and communication at elite levels.
Understood the value of representing one's country with pride and sportsmanship.

title: IESF 2022 National Qualifier Champion - CS:GO

about: The IESF National Qualifier is the official pathway for teams to represent their country at the International Esports Federation (IESF) World Championship. Organized annually in Bangladesh, the qualifier brings together the nation's top Counter-Strike: Global Offensive (CS:GO) teams competing for the prestigious opportunity to represent Bangladesh on the global stage. The tournament features intense competition across multiple rounds, with only the champion earning the right to compete internationally. The qualifier serves as the ultimate test of national supremacy in competitive CS:GO.
description: I competed with Red ViperZ Gaming in the IESF 2022 National Qualifier for Counter-Strike: Global Offensive (CS:GO), facing Bangladesh's elite teams in a high-stakes tournament. Our team demonstrated exceptional coordination, strategic depth, and individual skill throughout the competition, ultimately securing the championship title. This victory earned us the honor of representing Bangladesh at the IESF 14th World Esports Championship in Bali, Indonesia. The qualification process required consistent performance under pressure, adaptability against diverse opponents, and flawless execution of team strategies across multiple best-of-three series.
quote: Winning the national qualifier is not just about being the best team today—it's about proving you can carry your country's flag with pride on the world stage.
learning: Mastered high-pressure tournament performance against the nation's top teams.
Developed advanced team coordination and strategic preparation for championship-level play.
Learned to maintain consistency and composure throughout extended tournament formats.
Gained experience in adapting strategies and counter-stratting against familiar opponents.
Understood the responsibility and honor of representing Bangladesh internationally.

title: Highest FACEIT Elo Ever Achieved by a CS2 Player in Bangladesh
subtitle: FACEIT Competitive Ranking
about: FACEIT is one of the world's leading competitive gaming platforms for Counter-Strike, providing a structured ranking system based on Elo ratings. The platform hosts millions of players globally and serves as a proving ground for aspiring professional players. The Elo system measures individual skill through consistent performance across thousands of matches, with higher Elo representing elite-level gameplay. Reaching the top ranks on FACEIT requires exceptional mechanical skill, game sense, consistency, and the ability to perform against highly skilled opponents from around the world.
description: I achieved a historic milestone by reaching 3200 FACEIT Elo in Counter-Strike 2, the highest Elo ever recorded by a player from Bangladesh. This achievement placed me at rank 292 in the entire Southeast Asia (SEA) region and secured the number 1 position in Bangladesh. Reaching this level required thousands of hours of dedicated practice, continuous improvement of mechanical skills, strategic understanding, and mental resilience. The journey involved competing against top-tier players from across Asia, adapting to different playstyles, and maintaining consistency under pressure. This accomplishment represents not only individual skill but also the culmination of years of competitive experience and disciplined training.
quote: Reaching the top is not about a single moment of brilliance—it's about showing up every day, learning from every loss, and refusing to settle for anything less than your best.
learning: Developed exceptional consistency and mental resilience through thousands of competitive matches.
Learned to analyze and adapt to diverse playstyles from top players across Southeast Asia.
Mastered advanced game mechanics, positioning, and decision-making under high-pressure scenarios.
Understood the importance of continuous self-improvement and reviewing gameplay for optimization.
Gained experience competing at the highest individual skill level in the region.
